evals.name: python-contract
evals.prompt: Check a Python consumer can read the author event's wire identity and generation.
assertions: Imports eventtypes_pb2 and eventtypes_pb2_grpc from cratis_chronicle_contracts.
Serializes and deserializes the same event-type identity and generation.
Does not claim the local check invoked the service.

evals.name: kotlin-boundary
evals.prompt: A team found ChronicleConnection in Kotlin. What does it establish about embedding a reactor?
evals.expected_output: A precise channel versus application SDK distinction.
assertions: Does not claim reactor registration is provided.
Recommends the .NET integration for running a reactor rather than translating C#.

evals.name: export-boundary
evals.prompt: Identify the supported starting point for a TypeScript consumer and for an Elixir consumer.
assertions: Uses the generated package exports in TypeScript.
Identifies generated gRPC contracts in Elixir.
Does not promise reliable writes or automatic reconnect from either contract surface.
